verdict.rationale: Community Phone is a home and business phone service with an app, an online dashboard and multi-user business plans, so issuing scoped API credentials to an agent is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no public API, no API keys or tokens, and no scoped or least-privilege credential issuance, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Adding business users and managing numbers is a related account-management feature, not API credential scoping, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
